sonnet.problem: The setup line calls Barzillai's sons a name on David's list you'd actually WANT to be on. That tells the baker the instruction for them is a good one, which rules out the wrong answers 'careful watch' and 'stern justice' on the choice card that follows (card 10).
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The wrong answer 'Left to go down in peace' reuses the idea shown on card 8, whose right answer was 'Not let him die in peace' (v. 6 wording). Card 8 already lets the baker eliminate this option, so it isn't a fresh distractor.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
